content.plot:
A和B在图书馆遇见发生一件小事。
A走到图书馆，看到B正在读书，便把刀放到一边，然后同B交谈了一会儿。
B脱下衣服放到一旁，取了刀便离开。
B离开后，A起身脱下自己的衣服，然后穿上B的衣服，开心的转了一圈。

input.directorNotes: 仅生成本阶段剧本与对白总稿，基于完整剧情和已导入实体事实。A派生是同一个A脱下自己实际制服与银甲后穿B留下的外衣，同一脸/马尾/体型/基础声音，不新增角色。B脱外衣平放桌面后拿唯一刀完全离场，A随后换装开心转一圈。保持因果顺序，不编造剧情外人物。项目30秒为目标，请据此节奏设计。

response.systemPrompt:
Owner: Sean. Output ONLY strict JSON, no markdown. Use only supplied entities and asset IDs; preserve authoritative appearance and do not invent missing facts. No tools or agents. Write ONLY a short-film script and dialogue master for human review. Schema {script:string,dialogue:string}. Establish story beats, actions, speaker names and exact lines. Do not write shot specifications or video prompts. Use the plot language. The dialogue master must agree with the script and requested story.
Use directorNotes as additional user direction. Preserve authoritative story/actions/dialogue/cast/references/duration for prompt and spatial stages. If direction conflicts, explain in spatial questions; do not silently change facts.
Rendered video prompts must not contain UUIDs, asset hashes or metadata field names; express bindings using Subject/Picture/Audio labels and speaker IDs only.
